target.title: fix(fal): route grok-imagine and nano-banana-2-lite edits to correct endpoints
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Reference-image calls for these fal-hosted models fell through to `/image-to-image`, which fal does not expose:

- `xai/grok-imagine-image`
- `google/nano-banana-2-lite`

Both models expose standard edits at `/edit`. Grok also has a separate, explicitly selectable `/quality/edit` tier.

The original fix also exposed two shared-runtime gaps: inferred resolution was applied before fallback selection, and the generic tool parser could not accept Nano Banana's documented 14 reference images.

## Why This Change Was Made

The fal plugin keeps endpoint and request-shape behavior in its existing model schema:

- Base Grok edits append `/edit`; an explicit `/quality/edit` model path remains unchanged.
- Nano Banana 2 Lite edits append `/edit`.
- Grok uses its published aspect-ratio set, lowercase `1k`/`2k` wire values, and three-reference-image limit.
- Nano Banana 2 Lite uses its published aspect-ratio set and 14-reference-image limit.
- Nano Banana 2 Lite resolution overrides are rejected because the published base and edit schemas do not expose a `resolution` field.

The shared runtime now carries inferred resolution separately and applies it only after selecting each candidate model. A fallback that does not support resolution therefore receives no stale override, while a capable fallback still receives the inferred default. The generic reference-image parser accepts the provider maximum of 14; Fal's existing model schema continues to enforce each concrete model's lower limit per attempt.

The generic endpoint fallback remains `/image-to-image`, while existing GPT Image, Nano Banana 2, Flux, and Krea routing is unchanged.

## User Impact

Reference-image calls for these two model IDs now reach their standard fal edit endpoints instead of failing with a 404. Explicit Grok quality-edit requests remain opt-in. Mixed-capability fallback chains no longer leak an inferred resolution to a model that rejects it, and supported Nano Banana edits can use all 14 reference images.

## Evidence

- Contributor live probes reproduced 404s from the old `/image-to-image` routes and 200 responses from valid fal routes.
- Fal's current OpenAPI publishes distinct `xai/grok-imagine-image/edit` and `xai/grok-imagine-image/quality/edit` endpoints; the base model therefore maps to the standard `/edit` tier.
- Fal's current OpenAPI publishes `google/nano-banana-2-lite/edit` and omits `resolution` from both Nano Banana 2 Lite base and edit input schemas.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/fal/image-generation-provider.test.ts extensions/fal/music-generation-provider.test.ts extensions/fal/video-generation-provider.test.ts src/agents/tools/image-generate-tool.test.ts src/image-generation/runtime.test.ts` - 129/129 passed.
- `git diff --check` - passed.
- Fresh structured autoreview on the final maintainer repair - clean, no actionable findings, confidence 0.96.

Fixes the broken edit routing described in this PR.
